model: BiGRU 2-layer + gated-attention MIL pooling (per-ply instance logits pooled over the suspect side's plies)
corpus: synthetic anomaly corpus v2 (data/anomaly_corpus_v2, Maia bands with Stockfish 16 / Lc0 substitutions, real countdown clocks)
split_description: twin-safe grouped split: 70/15/15 train/val/test by (band, game index), so no game twin crosses partitions; bands 1300 and 1700 and substitution rate 10 percent are withheld from training entirely (split seed 42)

config.selection: max validation AUC over hidden in {64,128} x dropout in {0.1,0.3}, seed 0

per_move_localization_withheld_band.note: per-move instance logits localize substituted moves at or below chance; the app does not use them for critical moves

feature_definitions.r_hat_suspect: rating model's per-ply estimate for the suspect side (Elo scale)
feature_definitions.r_hat_other: rating model's per-ply estimate for the other side
feature_definitions.dev_signed: r_hat_suspect minus the suspect side's baseline (corpus: Maia band)
feature_definitions.alpha_n: rating model attention weight at this ply times the number of plies scored
feature_definitions.run_mean: running mean of r_hat_suspect up to this ply
feature_definitions.run_std: running standard deviation of r_hat_suspect up to this ply
feature_definitions.first_diff: r_hat_suspect minus its previous-ply value (0 at ply 0)
feature_definitions.second_diff: first_diff minus its previous-ply value (0 at ply 0)
feature_definitions.is_capture: the move played at this ply captures
feature_definitions.is_check: the move played at this ply gives check
feature_definitions.material_balance: material before the move (P1 N3 B3 R5 Q9), suspect side's point of view
feature_definitions.clock_remaining: remaining clock in seconds after this ply
feature_definitions.clock_delta: same-side clock two plies back minus this ply's clock (NaN when either is missing or ply < 2)
feature_definitions.is_suspect_move: this ply belongs to the side being scored

standardization.source: mean/std over training-split plies (scores.npz feat_mu, feat_sd); non-finite values set to 0 after standardizing
